questions.correctAnswer: Data and applications are defined separately
questions.explanation: Data independence (logical and physical) means application programs do not depend on the physical storage structure or logical schema changes. Data and programs are decoupled.

questions.questionText: If you want to allow subclasses to access data fields or methods defined in the super-class, but not to allow non-subclasses to access these data fields or methods, Which access modifier is appropriate?
questions.explanation: The protected access modifier allows access within the same package and by subclasses (even in different packages), but not by unrelated classes.

questions.questionText: Which phase of software development process refers to modification of software to reflect changing customer and market requirements?
questions.explanation: Software evolution (maintenance) is the ongoing process of modifying software after delivery to meet new requirements, fix bugs, or adapt to changing environments.

questions.questionText: Which network security issue shows the level of weakness in networks and devices?
questions.explanation: A vulnerability is a weakness or flaw in a system that can be exploited by an attacker. An attack is the actual exploitation.

questions.questionText: Suppose you have received a message from your friend but the message is scrambled for the sake of security. Your friend has used a program to encode messages into scrambled text. In order to read the message which program would you use?
questions.explanation: Decryption reverses the encryption process using the appropriate key to convert ciphertext back to plaintext.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following Java fragment code?
questions.correctAnswer: The code fragment is not provided in the document text
questions.explanation: The Java code fragment is not included in the provided document text.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is false about arrays in C++?
options: An array is a collection of similar data objects
We use [ ] square bracket at the time of array declaration
Size of an array should be constant at the time of array declaration
We can access elements of arrays without using index number
questions.correctAnswer: We can access elements of arrays without using index number
questions.explanation: In C++ arrays are accessed only via index (subscript). All other statements are true.

questions.questionText: A computer expert would like to know the number of processes that are completed per hour to assess the performance of the machine. Therefore, which one of the following best describes the expert’s assessment?
questions.explanation: Throughput measures the number of processes completed per unit time (e.g., jobs per hour). Waiting time, response time, and turnaround time are per-process metrics.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a step in problem solving that lists the actions and states the agent has to consider provided a goal.
questions.explanation: Problem formulation defines the state space, actions, goal test, and path cost—i.e., the set of actions and states the agent must consider.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not true about fan trap in Entity Relationship Diagram?
options: It can be resolved by readjusting the model so that no one-to-many relationships fanning out from an entity
Highly likely exit when more than two one-to-many relationships fan out from an entity
When there is ambiguous pathway between some entity occurrence in related entity types
It occurs when there is no pathway between related entities
questions.correctAnswer: It occurs when there is no pathway between related entities
questions.explanation: A fan trap occurs when two or more 1:M relationships fan out from the same entity, creating ambiguous pathways. “No pathway” describes a different modeling error (chasm trap).

questions.questionText: A process is terminated by the operating system due to a reference to non-existing memory. Which one of the following best explains the process termination?
questions.explanation: A fatal error (e.g., segmentation fault, access to invalid memory) causes the OS to terminate the process abnormally.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following fragment C++ code?
questions.correctAnswer: The code fragment is not provided in the document text
questions.explanation: The C++ code fragment is not included in the provided document text.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is correct way creating String object?
questions.explanation: The correct syntax uses double quotes for the string literal inside the constructor. Single quotes are for char, and the other options have syntax errors.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a security service enforced to protect discloser of information, which can be stored in a file or being on transmission, from unauthorized entities?
questions.explanation: Confidentiality prevents unauthorized disclosure of information (whether at rest or in transit). Authentication verifies identity, integrity prevents modification, availability ensures access.

questions.questionText: Which statement is false about universal hashing technique?
options: Universal hashing reduces the chance of data collision
In universal hashing a hash function is selected randomly from a set of hash functions for each key
Single fixed hash function technique is better than universal hashing technique in terms of collision reduction
In universal hashing a hash function is selected from set of hash functions independent of keys.
questions.correctAnswer: Single fixed hash function technique is better than universal hashing technique in terms of collision reduction
questions.explanation: Universal hashing is designed to minimize the worst-case collision probability by randomly selecting a hash function from a family. A single fixed hash function can be attacked (adversary can force many collisions).

questions.questionText: is set of attribute that can be seen by a program and can have direct impact on the logical execution of a program.
questions.explanation: Computer architecture is the set of attributes (instruction set, registers, addressing modes, etc.) that are visible to the programmer and affect the logical execution of a program.

questions.questionText: is the whole thing that an agent has observed so far concerning the existing scenario in the environment
questions.explanation: In AI agent terminology, the percept sequence is everything the agent has perceived so far.

questions.questionText: In a tree data structure, if a node has no parent node, then the node is
questions.explanation: By definition, the root is the only node in a tree that has no parent.

questions.questionText: In which situation that using database management system (DBMS) becomes costly and not recommended to use it?
options: In embedded systems having too small storage space
In situation where more than users should access the database
To deny access to unauthorized users.
questions.correctAnswer: In embedded systems having too small storage space
questions.explanation: DBMS software itself requires significant memory, disk space, and processing overhead. In resource-constrained embedded systems, a simple file system is preferred.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is correct about human role in system administration?
options: It requires patience, understanding and knowledge
System-administrator is not expected to have skills and confidence
Ethics is not a requirement to manage computers.
questions.correctAnswer: It requires patience, understanding and knowledge
questions.explanation: System administration demands technical knowledge, patience when troubleshooting, understanding of user needs, organizational skills, and strong ethics. The other statements are false.

questions.questionText: Which type of Turing machine has two tapes, one tape read-only and the other read-write type?
questions.explanation: An off-line Turing machine has a read-only input tape and a separate read-write work tape.

questions.questionText: Assume you have a weighted graph G with a set of vertices V and set of edges E. Which one of the following problem is an optimization problem on the graph?
options: How many cycles are there in graph G
Traverse all vertices in graph G
Find minimum spanning tree from graph G
Is vertex p∊V reachable from vertex q∊V in graph G
questions.correctAnswer: Find minimum spanning tree from graph G
questions.explanation: Finding a Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) is an optimization problem (minimize total edge weight while connecting all vertices). The others are decision or traversal problems.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of an opcode that is as indicated in the figure below? 4 bits 6 bits 6 bits Opcode Operand Reference Operand Reference ←—-------------------------------------16 bits >
options: It holds the destination address of an operand
It holds the source address of an operand
It determines the operation to be done
It holds the next instruction reference
questions.correctAnswer: It determines the operation to be done
questions.explanation: The opcode (operation code) field tells the CPU which instruction to execute (add, load, jump, etc.). The operand fields specify addresses or data.

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following JavaScript statement ? Math.sqrt(36)
questions.explanation: Math.sqrt(36) returns the square root of 36, which is 6.

questions.questionText: Assume you have a universe of key U. Which one is false statement regarding Direct Access table and Hash Table data structures?
options: If universe U is very large, Hash table is better than Direct Address table
There is one to one correspondence between keys in the universe U and memory slots in the Direct Address table
Direct Address table doesn’t use hash function to map keys
Hash table allocates one separate memory slot for each key in the universe U
questions.correctAnswer: Hash table allocates one separate memory slot for each key in the universe U
questions.explanation: A hash table uses a hash function and can have collisions, so it does not allocate one slot per possible key (especially when U is huge). Direct addressing does allocate one slot per key in U.

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following JavaScript statement? Math.floor(5.9)
questions.explanation: Math.floor returns the largest integer less than or equal to the number → floor(5.9) = 5.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following algorithms can be used to extract Minimum Spanning Tree from an input graph?
questions.explanation: Prim’s algorithm (and Kruskal’s) finds a Minimum Spanning Tree. Dijkstra finds shortest paths, Huffman is for compression, Merge sort is for sorting.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not delimiter of PHP code?
questions.explanation: <caption> is an HTML tag, not a PHP delimiter. The other three are valid PHP opening/closing tags.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following best explains attackers who are motivated by financial gain and perform sabotage and IP theft and secret of a rival company?
questions.explanation: Corporate competitors (industrial espionage) are motivated by financial gain and steal intellectual property or sabotage rivals.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is true about frames in HTML?
options: Frames allow parts of the page to remain stationary while other parts scroll
Frames are not difficult to handle doe search engines
Load on the server is not affected if there are a large number of of frames in a page
questions.correctAnswer: Frames allow parts of the page to remain stationary while other parts scroll
questions.explanation: Frames (or iframes) keep certain parts static while others scroll. Modern browsers have limited support, frames hurt SEO, and multiple frames increase server load.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following does not show non-functional requirement of software systems?
questions.explanation: Display information is a functional requirement (what the system does). Memory requirement, reliability, and response time are non-functional (how well it does it).

questions.questionText: Which layer uses port number to identify applications?
questions.explanation: The Transport layer (TCP/UDP) uses port numbers to multiplex and demultiplex data to the correct application/process.

questions.questionText: Which concept refers to extending specialized classes from generalized classes in object-oriented programming?
questions.explanation: Inheritance allows a specialized (child) class to extend a generalized (parent) class, inheriting its attributes and methods.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a two-level cache having an internal and external caches?
questions.explanation: A multilevel cache (L1 internal + L2 external) is exactly a two-level hierarchy. Split cache separates instruction/data at the same level; unified is combined.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about packet and circuit switching?
options: Packet Switching is more efficient than circuit switching
In packet switching and end-to-end connection has to be established
In circuit switching a channel is dedicatedly used
In packet switching message are send in small blocks.
questions.correctAnswer: In packet switching and end-to-end connection has to be established
questions.explanation: Packet switching is connectionless (datagram) or uses virtual circuits; it does not require a dedicated end-to-end connection for every packet like circuit switching does. The other statements are true.

questions.questionText: Among the following which one best describes a data management system (DBMS)?
options: It is responsible for creating and maintaining a database
I can help users to manage computers activity
It can assist you to process document
questions.correctAnswer: It is responsible for creating and maintaining a database
questions.explanation: A DBMS is software that creates, manages, and maintains databases, providing controlled access, concurrency control, backup, etc.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about computer architecture and organization?
options: An organization can last for long time as an architecture does
An architecture can remain for long time but its organization can change
An architecture can be used for long time encompassing different computer model
Manufactures offer computer with same architecture but different organization
questions.correctAnswer: An organization can last for long time as an architecture does
questions.explanation: Architecture (ISA) remains stable for decades; organization (microarchitecture, implementation) changes frequently with technology. The other statements are correct.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about transaction failure?
options: Transaction fail if logical errors are detected
Concurrency control enforcement avoid transaction failure
Catastrophes can be cause of transaction failure
Transaction fail if disk blocks lost their data
questions.correctAnswer: Concurrency control enforcement avoid transaction failure
questions.explanation: Concurrency control prevents certain anomalies but does not prevent all transaction failures (logical errors, system crashes, disk failures still cause failure).

questions.questionText: Among phase of compiling process in which phase a sequence of character are converted into a sequence of tokens?
questions.explanation: Lexical analysis (scanning) converts the character stream into a token stream.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about threads?
options: Treads have register to hold its working memory
Treads are the entities schedule for execution on the CPU
It is a group of processes
questions.correctAnswer: It is a group of processes
questions.explanation: A thread is a lightweight unit within a process, not a group of processes. Each thread has its own PC, registers, and stack but shares the process’s address space.

questions.questionText: Which asymptotic notation describes average case analysis?
questions.explanation: When best, worst, and average are the same order, we use tight Θ notation. Big-O is upper bound (often used for worst), Ω is lower bound.

questions.questionText: Which one of data update best describes the following statement? “All modified data items in the cache is written either after transaction ends its execution or after a pre-determined number of transactions have concluded their execution”.
questions.explanation: Deferred update (NO-UNDO/REDO) writes changes to the database only after the transaction commits.

questions.questionText: Given input Alphabet ∑ = {a, b, c, d} and empty string 𝛌, Then which one of the following is true about ∑*
questions.explanation: Kleene star (∑*) includes the empty string and all possible concatenations (∑+ is the positive closure without ε).

questions.questionText: Linked list data structure is type of data structure.
questions.explanation: Linked lists grow and shrink at run time (dynamic allocation). Arrays are static/fixed-size.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is true about java and JavaScript
options: JavaScript can be used in extremely sophisticated application
JavaScript is compiled and interpreted in source code form
There are more features in JavaScript than java.
questions.explanation: Both Java and JavaScript support object-oriented programming (Java fully, JavaScript via prototypes). The other statements are false or misleading.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not correct about POP3 and SMPT?
options: A sender can receive emails using POP3
A sender can send email using SMTP
questions.explanation: POP3 and SMTP are Application-layer protocols (TCP/IP model). SMTP is for sending, POP3 for retrieving.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is responsible for separating some machine from the rest to shield them from possible attacks?
questions.explanation: A firewall separates a trusted internal network from an untrusted external network and filters traffic to protect against attacks.

questions.questionText: Give the schemas BOOK (Book_id, Title, Publisher_name) BOOK_AUTHOR(Book_id,Author_name) PUBLISHER(Name, Address, Phone).Which one of the following SQL is correct to delete the publisher name as XWZ from PUBLISHER table
questions.explanation: To delete a publisher by name from the PUBLISHER table, we must target the correct table and use the Name column (assuming XWZ is the name value).

questions.questionText: which one of the following is a measure taken to ensure information and information systems’ availability, integrity, authentication and confidentiality
questions.explanation: Information assurance is the practice of protecting and defending information and systems by ensuring availability, integrity, authentication, confidentiality, and non-repudiation.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true about pop () operations of Stack data structure
options: pop() inserts new element at the beginning/bottom of stack
pop() return the end/top element but it doesn’t delete that element
pop() remove the end/top element from the stack
pop() insert new element at the middle of stack
questions.correctAnswer: pop() remove the end/top element from the stack
questions.explanation: The pop operation removes and returns the top element of the stack (LIFO).

questions.questionText: Let a Grammar G = ({S}, {a, b}, S, P), where {S} is set of variables {a, b} is set of terminal symbols, S is start variable and P is set of productions. Then which one of the following is not an element of the language (L) (L) which is generated from G. Given P: S —> aSb, S —> 𝛌
questions.explanation: The grammar generates strings of the form a^n b^n (including ε). “a” (one a, zero b) cannot be generated. ab, aabb, and ε can.

questions.questionText: Which of the following phase is done before semantic analysis phase of compiling process?
questions.explanation: The compiler phases order is: Lexical → Syntax analysis → Semantic analysis → Intermediate code → Optimization → Code generation. Syntax analysis precedes semantic analysis.

questions.questionText: Given input Alphabets ∑= {a, b, c, d} and empty string 𝛌 Then, which one of the following is equivalent to ∑0??
questions.explanation: ∑^0 is defined as the set containing only the empty string ε (by convention, any set to the power 0 is {ε}).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is valid statement regarding PHP variables?
questions.explanation: PHP variables must start with $. The first option is syntactically correct (float assignment). The others have missing $ or unclosed quotes.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity order of binary searching algorithms?
questions.explanation: Binary search repeatedly halves the search space, giving O(log n) time complexity.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is different from the other based on its role in computer network?
questions.explanation: Wireless access point, hubs, and routers are all network interconnection devices. A network printer is an end device (host), not a networking device.

questions.questionText: Which type of variable can be accessed through out our C++ program scope?
questions.explanation: A global variable declared outside any function has program-wide scope and can be accessed from any function.

questions.questionText: For an input graph. Depth First Traversal algorithm users data structure to travers
questions.explanation: DFS uses a stack (explicit or via recursion) to explore as far as possible along each branch before backtracking.

questions.questionText: Consider the following fragment of C++ code const int x =8; const int y = 16; if (x>y) { int z = x + y; } For code like the above one, which technique of the code optimization is appropriate?
questions.explanation: The if condition (8 > 16) is always false, so the entire block inside the if is unreachable dead code and can be eliminated by the compiler.

questions.questionText: Assume that p, x, y, and z are int variables with x = 1, y = 10, z = -3. Which of the following is true after the following statement is executed? p= (x++ * y--) + ++z;
questions.explanation: The expression evaluates as follows: x++ uses the current value of x (1) and then increments x to 2; y-- uses the current value of y (10) and then decrements y to 9; ++z first increments z from -3 to -2 and then uses -2. So p = (1 * 10) + (-2) = 8. Option a (22) would require different operator precedence or no post-increment. Option b (17) assumes incorrect ordering. Option d (16) assumes ++z before multiplication or wrong values.

questions.questionText: What will happen in the following C++ code snippet? int a = 100, b = 200; int *p = &a, *q = &b; p = q;
options: a. p now points to b
b. a is assigned to b
c. b is assigned to a
d. q now points to a
questions.correctAnswer: a. p now points to b
questions.explanation: The statement p = q; assigns the address stored in q (address of b) to p. Now p points to the same location as q (i.e., b). No value is copied between a and b, and q is unchanged. Options b and c would require *p = *q; or similar dereferencing.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best describes the statement “C++ is a case sensitive programming language”?
options: a. All variables in C++ are identifiers
b. Every C++ statement should include the header file iostream.h
c. ExitExam and exitExam are distinct in C++
d. Every statement in C++ ends with semicolon
questions.correctAnswer: c. ExitExam and exitExam are distinct in C++
questions.explanation: C++ treats uppercase and lowercase letters as different (case-sensitive). So ExitExam and exitExam are two different identifiers. The other options are either always true or unrelated to case sensitivity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about the statement a=b;
options: a. The value of a and b are equal
b. The value of b is assigned to variable a and the later change on variable b will affect the value of variable a
c. The value of variable a is assigned to variable b and the value of variable b is assigned to variable a
d. The value of b is assigned to variable a and the later change on variable b will not affect the value of variable a
questions.correctAnswer: d. The value of b is assigned to variable a and the later change on variable b will not affect the value of variable a
questions.explanation: The assignment operator copies the value of b into a. After this, a and b are independent; changing b later does not affect a. Option a is the result, not the meaning of the statement. Option b describes reference/pointer semantics. Option c describes swapping.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is true statement about an algorithm?
options: a. Ambiguous steps are allowed in an algorithm.
b. Complex problems cannot have an algorithm.
c. An algorithm may not have a beginning and an end.
d. An algorithm should take finite amount of time to compute.
questions.correctAnswer: d. An algorithm should take finite amount of time to compute.
questions.explanation: One of the five fundamental properties of an algorithm is finiteness — it must terminate after a finite number of steps. Ambiguous steps (a) violate definiteness, complex problems can have algorithms (b), and every algorithm must have a start and end (c).

questions.questionText: Which of the following will NOT increase an integer variable "i" by 1?
questions.explanation: i=i+i; doubles the current value of i (e.g., if i=5 it becomes 10). All other options add exactly 1 to i.

questions.questionText: What will happen in the following C++ code snippet? int a = 100, b = 200; int *p = &a, *q = &b; p = q;
options: a. p now points to b
b. b is assigned to a
c. a is assigned to b
d. q now points to a
questions.correctAnswer: a. p now points to b
questions.explanation: Same as question 2 — p = q; makes p point to b. No value assignment occurs between a and b.

questions.questionText: Given three classes A, B and C, where class C is derived from class B, which is derived from class A. If those classes are public classes and found in different package, then a class C object can access
options: a. Any data in C and Only Protected and public data in A and B.
b. Protected, default and public data only in C and B.
c. Any data in C and only public data in A and B.
d. Protected, default and public data only in C.
questions.correctAnswer: a. Any data in C and Only Protected and public data in A and B.
questions.explanation: In Java, a subclass can access its own members (any access), protected and public members of superclasses (even across packages), but not default (package-private) members from different packages. Option b and d include default access incorrectly across packages.

questions.questionText: If the method is not static; how to invoke in the java programming language?
questions.explanation: Non-static (instance) methods must be called on an object reference. Static methods can be called via class name.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is correct, when an overridden method is called from within a subclass?
options: a. The Compiler will choose randomly the method to be executed
b. It will always refer to the version of that method defined by the subclass
c. Compile time error will occur
d. It will always refer to the version of that method defined by the superclass
questions.correctAnswer: b. It will always refer to the version of that method defined by the subclass
questions.explanation: This is runtime polymorphism (dynamic method dispatch). When an overridden method is called through a superclass reference that actually points to a subclass object, the subclass version executes.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements not true?
options: a. A private member of a class cannot be accessed by the methods of the same class
b. A public member of a class can be accessed in all the packages
c. A private member of a class cannot be accessed from its derived class
d. A protected member of a class can be accessed from its derived class.
questions.correctAnswer: a. A private member of a class cannot be accessed by the methods of the same class
questions.explanation: Private members ARE accessible by methods of the same class. They cannot be accessed from subclasses or other classes (option c is true). Public members are accessible everywhere (b true). Protected members are accessible in subclasses (d true).

questions.questionText: _________is one of the basic principles of object oriented programming that use one object in multiple forms.
questions.explanation: The ability of one object to take many forms is called Polymorphism. None of the listed options is polymorphism.

questions.questionText: Consider the program: public class Student { int id; int section; void display(){ System.out.println(“ID : ” + id); System.out.println(“Section : ” + section);} public static void main(String[] args){ /*Create an object*/ }} Which of the following is a correct way to create an object in the main method of the above program?
questions.explanation: The class has no constructor that takes parameters, so only the default no-argument constructor can be used. Option C is the only syntactically correct way to instantiate the object.

questions.questionText: Suppose we want to determine the efficiency of the algorithm, then how we can measure the space factor
options: a. To count the maximum memory required by the algorithm
b. To count the average memory required by the algorithm
c. To count the minimum memory required by the algorithm
d. To count the maximum disk space needed by the algorithm
questions.correctAnswer: a. To count the maximum memory required by the algorithm
questions.explanation: Space complexity measures the maximum amount of memory (auxiliary space + input size) an algorithm needs in the worst case.

questions.questionText: Two main measures for the efficiency of an algorithm are
questions.explanation: The two primary efficiency measures are time complexity (how fast) and space complexity (how much memory).

questions.questionText: What is the best time complexity we can achieve to precompute all-pairs shortest paths in a weighted graph?
questions.explanation: Floyd-Warshall algorithm computes all-pairs shortest paths in O(n³) time, which is optimal for dense graphs.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity of optimal binary search tree?
questions.explanation: The standard dynamic-programming solution for constructing an optimal BST runs in O(n²) time.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the space complexity of a recursive algorithm with n levels of recursion and O(1) space complexity in each level?
questions.explanation: Each recursive call adds a new stack frame (constant space per level). With n levels of recursion, total space used by the call stack is O(n).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the best case time complexity of linear search algorithm?
questions.explanation: In the best case the target is found at the first position, requiring only one comparison → O(1).

questions.questionText: If the elements '1', '2', '3' and '4' are inserted in a queue, what would be order for the removal?
questions.explanation: Queue follows FIFO (First-In-First-Out). Elements are removed in the same order they were inserted: 1, 2, 3, 4.

questions.questionText: What is the disadvantage of array data structure?
options: a. The amount of memory to be allocated should be known beforehand.
b. Elements of an array can be accessed in constant time.
c. Elements are stored in contiguous memory blocks.
d. Multiple other data structures can be implemented using arrays.
questions.correctAnswer: a. The amount of memory to be allocated should be known beforehand.
questions.explanation: Static arrays require the size to be known at compile time (or at allocation). This is a major disadvantage compared to dynamic structures like linked lists.

questions.questionText: What is the maximum number of swaps that can be performed in the Selection Sort algorithm?
questions.explanation: Selection sort performs at most one swap per pass for n-1 passes, so maximum n-1 swaps.

questions.questionText: What would be the time complexity if user tries to insert the element at the end of the linked list (head pointer is known)?
questions.explanation: With only a head pointer, reaching the last node requires traversing all n nodes, so insertion at the end is O(n).

questions.questionText: Which data structure is required to convert the infix to prefix notation?
questions.explanation: The standard algorithm for infix-to-prefix (or postfix) conversion uses a stack to handle operator precedence and parentheses.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the process of inserting an element in the stack?
questions.explanation: The standard terminology for adding an element to a stack is “push”.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a Divide and Conquer algorithm?
questions.explanation: Merge Sort divides the array into two halves, recursively sorts them, and then merges — classic divide-and-conquer. Heap, selection, and bubble sort do not follow this paradigm.

questions.questionText: ----------is a collection of multiple logically related database distributed over a computer network.
questions.explanation: A distributed database physically stores data across multiple sites connected by a network while appearing as a single logical database.

questions.questionText: ............... Means that a transaction must execute exactly once completely or not at all.
questions.explanation: Atomicity (the “A” in ACID) guarantees that a transaction is treated as a single indivisible unit — all operations succeed or none do.

questions.questionText: A language that used to formulate the schema of database structure is______.
questions.explanation: DDL (CREATE, ALTER, DROP, etc.) is used to define and modify the database schema.

questions.questionText: A table can have only one
questions.explanation: A table can have only one primary key (which may consist of multiple columns). It can have multiple unique keys, candidate keys, and foreign keys.

questions.questionText: Checkpoints are a part of
questions.explanation: Checkpoints are used in database recovery to reduce the amount of work needed after a crash by marking consistent states.

questions.questionText: When the values in one or more attributes being used as a foreign key must exist there must be a corresponding primary key value in another table in the database, we have created___________
questions.explanation: Referential integrity ensures that a foreign key value always matches a primary key value in the referenced table (or is null).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a feature of DBMS?
options: d. Minimum Duplication and Redundancy of Data
questions.explanation: Modern DBMSes support multi-user concurrent access with locking and concurrency control. Single-user access is not a feature.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a function of the database?
questions.explanation: Code analysis is performed by compilers/IDEs, not by a DBMS. All other options are core DBMS functions.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a recovery technique?
questions.explanation: Two-phase commit is a distributed transaction protocol for atomicity across sites, not a recovery technique. ARIES, immediate update, and deferred update are recovery methods.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true about OODBMS (object-oriented database management system).
options: a. The key concepts is objects
c. The key concept is relation
questions.correctAnswer: c. The key concept is relation
questions.explanation: OODBMS is based on objects, not relations (which is the foundation of RDBMS).

questions.questionText: Which of the following techniques of query optimization is uses ordering of the operation?
questions.explanation: Heuristic-based optimization rewrites queries using algebraic rules (e.g., push selection before join) to reduce cost without exhaustive enumeration.

questions.questionText: Which of the following relationship is matched correctly with appropriate example of MANY TO-ONE?
questions.explanation: Many employees work in one department → many-to-one. The others are one-to-one or many-to-many.

questions.questionText: During system design system decomposition is influenced by all except_______
questions.explanation: System decomposition is guided by coupling, cohesion, and functionality. “Users thinking” is not a technical design criterion.

questions.questionText: The functional model is represented graphically with —
questions.explanation: Use case diagrams show the functional requirements from the user’s perspective.

questions.questionText: Which of the following concept of software engineering is false statement.
options: a. System Analysis Focuses on the user’s view of the system
b. Design focuses on the developer point of view.
c. Result of system analysis is a model that includes a subsystem decomposition
d. Requirements elicitation focus only on the user’s view of the system.
questions.correctAnswer: c. Result of system analysis is a model that includes a subsystem decomposition
questions.explanation: Subsystem decomposition is part of system design, not analysis. Analysis produces a requirements model.

questions.questionText: Which of the following heuristics is not used to identify Entity objects
questions.explanation: Activities usually become operations/methods, not entity classes. Real-world entities, forms, and data sources are common heuristics for identifying classes.

questions.questionText: “Consider a system where, a heat sensor detects an intrusion and alerts the security company.” What kind of a requirement the system is providing?
questions.explanation: This describes what the system must do (detect intrusion and alert) — a functional requirement.

questions.questionText: which one of the following is used to Identifying Actors
options: a. What kind of dependencies are exist among use cases.
b. What information does the actor access?
c. Which user groups execute the system’s main functions?
d. What are the tasks that the actor wants the system to perform?
questions.correctAnswer: c. Which user groups execute the system’s main functions?
questions.explanation: Actors are external entities (user groups or other systems) that interact with the system. Option c directly identifies them.

questions.questionText: In PHP, which function is used to establish a secure connection to a MySQL database using SSL encryption?
questions.explanation: mysqli_ssl_connect() (or mysqli with SSL options) is the correct function in the mysqli extension for secure connections.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript function is used to display a dialog box with an alert message?
questions.explanation: window.alert() (or simply alert()) shows a modal dialog with a message.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript method is used to select an HTML element by its ID?
questions.explanation: document.getElementById('id') is the standard DOM method.

questions.questionText: Which language is used to add interactivity and dynamic behavior to a web page?
questions.explanation: JavaScript is the only client-side scripting language among the options for adding interactivity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following languages is primarily responsible for defining the structure and content of a web page?
questions.explanation: HTML defines the structure and semantic content. CSS handles presentation, JavaScript behavior, PHP server-side logic.

questions.questionText: Which PHP function is used to check if a file or directory exists?
questions.explanation: file_exists() returns true if the file or directory exists.

questions.questionText: Which PHP function is used to retrieve the number of rows affected by an SQL query?
questions.explanation: In mysqli, $mysqli->affected_rows or mysqli_affected_rows() gives the number of rows affected by the last INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.

questions.questionText: Which PHP superglobal array is used to retrieve information about the server and execution environment?
questions.explanation: $_SERVER contains server and execution environment information.

questions.questionText: Which PHP superglobal array is used to retrieve data sent from an HTML form using the POST method?
questions.explanation: $_POST contains data sent via HTTP POST.

questions.questionText: An agent type which has condition-action rule and memory to remind the current state of the world and its evolution is called
questions.explanation: Model-based reflex agents maintain an internal model (memory) of the world state and use condition-action rules.

questions.questionText: Assume that you are employed as a machine learning expert at the Ministry of Education (MoE). Which machine learning technique you would apply for the task of describing the existing higher education institutions as first generation, second generation and third generation.
questions.explanation: Grouping institutions into generations without labeled data is an unsupervised clustering task.

questions.questionText: Consider the definition of AI: “The effort to design and implement intelligent software that solves problems by identifying best action sequence to achieve the desired goal” can be views AI as
options: a. A system that acts humanly
b. A system that thinks humanly
c. A system that acts rationally
d. A system that thinks rationally
questions.correctAnswer: c. A system that acts rationally
questions.explanation: This definition matches the “acting rationally” view of AI (rational agent approach).

questions.questionText: What is completeness of search algorithms?
options: a. If there is a difference between the quality of goal states, the agent will find the best one
b. An estimate of how much information the algorithm needs to store for finding a solution
c. An estimate of how many search steps it takes to find a solution
d. Provided that a solution exists, the algorithm will find it
questions.correctAnswer: d. Provided that a solution exists, the algorithm will find it
questions.explanation: Completeness means the algorithm is guaranteed to find a solution if one exists.

questions.questionText: Which one of the view of defining AI concerned with thought processing
options: a. Viewing AI as a system which has complete autonomous
b. Viewing AI as a system that think either humanly or think rationally
c. Viewing AI as a system that act either humanly or think rationally
d. Viewing AI as a system that act omnisciently to its environment
questions.correctAnswer: b. Viewing AI as a system that think either humanly or think rationally
questions.explanation: The “thinking” views of AI (humanly or rationally) focus on internal thought processes.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statement is false
options: a. Turing test is a mechanism to validate AI system that act humanly
b. Validating AI system that act rationally can be made by its performance
c. Validating AI system that thinks humanly is impossible
d. Validating AI system that think rationally can be made by using its reasoning logic
questions.correctAnswer: c. Validating AI system that thinks humanly is impossible
questions.explanation: Validating “thinking humanly” is possible via cognitive modeling and the Turing test (for acting humanly). Option c is false.

questions.questionText: A context free Grammar is called ambiguous if there exists a string that can have?
options: d. more than one parse tree
questions.correctAnswer: d. more than one parse tree
questions.explanation: An ambiguous grammar has at least one string with more than one leftmost (or rightmost) derivation / parse tree.

questions.questionText: A context free grammar with production rules: S->aS / ε is equivalent to the regular expression
questions.explanation: The grammar generates zero or more a’s, which is exactly the regular expression a*.

questions.questionText: A push down automaton employs ________ data structure.
questions.explanation: A pushdown automaton uses a stack for memory.

questions.questionText: Which of the following Machine is Equivalent for Regular grammar?
questions.explanation: Regular languages are exactly those accepted by finite automata.

questions.questionText: Given a context free grammar G= {V, ∑, P, S} and production P: a->b. Which one of the following is true?
questions.explanation: In a production A → α, the left side A must be a non-terminal (∈ V), the right side α is a string over (V ∪ ∑)*. Here a is the left side, so a ∈ V; b is on the right, so b ∈ (V ∪ ∑)*.

questions.questionText: Given a finite automata below, what will be the regular expression that correctly represents the language accepted by it.
questions.explanation: The diagram (though not visible) leads to the regular expression in option A, as stated in the document.

questions.questionText: Identify the technique used to replace run-time computations with compile-time computations?
questions.explanation: Constant folding evaluates constant expressions at compile time (e.g., 2+3 → 5).

questions.questionText: In which does the compiler translate the source code?
questions.explanation: The compiler ultimately produces machine code (binary) that can be linked into an executable.

questions.questionText: Through which type of grammar can synthesized attributes can be simulated?
questions.explanation: S-attributed grammars (synthesized attributes only) can be evaluated during LR parsing.

questions.questionText: What is regular expression for an Identifier?
questions.explanation: Standard identifier: starts with a letter, followed by zero or more letters or digits.

questions.questionText: What is the process of finding a parse tree for a string of tokens called?
questions.explanation: Parsing (syntax analysis) builds the parse tree from the token stream.

questions.questionText: What is the action of parsing the source program into proper syntactic classes?
questions.explanation: Lexical analysis (scanning) groups characters into tokens (syntactic classes).

questions.questionText: All are properties of the integrity goal of a computer system, except
options: a. Integrity can be compromised by Deception
b. Integrity can be compromised by Disclosure
c. Ensures there was an authorized modification
d. Keep resources from active attacks
questions.correctAnswer: b. Integrity can be compromised by Disclosure
questions.explanation: Disclosure compromises confidentiality, not integrity. Deception, unauthorized modification, and active attacks affect integrity.

questions.questionText: Assume, you went to the Ethiopian airport to catch a flight and told the airport personnel your name. For sure, they would ask you some questions like your passport number and your reservation ticket number for some proof of your identity. Then what do we call this process?
questions.explanation: Verifying “who you are” by checking credentials is authentication.

questions.questionText: Assume, you went to the nearby commercial bank’s automatic teller machine (ATM) to withdraw money. You inserted your ATM card into the machine, and the machine asked you to enter your personal identification number (PIN). Then, when you type your password, someone intercepts your ATM card number, and which of your security goals is compromised?
questions.explanation: Intercepting the card number and PIN compromises confidentiality (secrecy of the information).

questions.questionText: Which attack can be used for monitoring children’s activity?
questions.explanation: Spyware secretly monitors user activity and sends information to a third party.

questions.questionText: _______is a type of data link layer attack in TCP/IP protocol stack
questions.explanation: ARP spoofing is Layer 2. DNS spoofing can be at application or transport. SYN-flood is a transport-layer (TCP) attack.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements is true about worms and Viruses
options: a. Worms requires a host to spread while viruses doesn’t require
b. Worms requires a user action for replicate while viruses doesn’t require
c. Virus requires a host to spread while Worms doesn’t require
d. Worms spreading speed is slower than Virus Spreading speed
questions.correctAnswer: c. Virus requires a host to spread while Worms doesn’t require
questions.explanation: Viruses attach to host files/programs. Worms are standalone and spread independently.

questions.questionText: What is the bit pattern for the first octet of a class –B network address?
questions.explanation: Class B addresses start with binary 10 (first octet 128–191).

questions.questionText: Which OSI model layer is responsible for flow control?
questions.explanation: The Transport layer (TCP) provides end-to-end flow control.

questions.questionText: Which of the following networking device is used in physical layer?
questions.explanation: Hubs operate only at the Physical layer (Layer 1), repeating signals.

questions.questionText: Assuming that Company VWX has main site and remote site. The main site has three LANs with LAN 1 has 100 hosts, LAN 2 has 60 hosts, and LAN 3 has 29 hosts. The remote site has two LANs, each with 100 hosts. The network uses private addresses. The Internet service provider assigned the company the network 200.100.50.2/26. The remote site uses the network prefix 192.168.10.0/24. What subnets and masks can you use for the LANs at the remote site and conserve address space?
questions.explanation: Each remote LAN needs at least 100 hosts → /25 (126 usable) is the smallest efficient subnet. Two /25 subnets fit perfectly in the /24.

questions.questionText: The main site uses the network prefix 192.168.15.0/24. What subnets and masks can you use to provide sufficient addresses for LANs at the main site and conserve address space?
questions.explanation: LAN 1 (100 hosts) needs /25, LAN 2 (60) needs /26, LAN 3 (29) needs /27. This allocation fits inside the /24 and wastes the least address space.

questions.questionText: Which network and mask would you use for the WAN link to save the most address space?
questions.explanation: A point-to-point WAN link needs only 2 usable addresses → /30 is the most efficient.

questions.questionText: In DNS concept the process of getting IP address by using its hostname is called: _________
questions.explanation: Forward DNS lookup (hostname → IP) is called forward resolution.

questions.questionText: Let’s assume that you know the domain name of Face Book server, but you don’t know its IP address. So which network troubleshooting tool you use to get its IP address?
questions.explanation: nslookup (or dig) performs DNS queries to resolve a hostname to an IP address.

questions.questionText: Where/when Network administrator should have to use the concept of Network Address translation? Network admin should use NAT where: -
options: a. Default gateway of LAN isn’t configured
b. Global IP address is used in the LAN
c. He/she don’t know type of IP address used in the LAN
d. Private IP address is used in the LAN
questions.correctAnswer: d. Private IP address is used in the LAN
questions.explanation: NAT is required when private (RFC 1918) addresses need to communicate with the public Internet.

questions.questionText: Where/When we can use DHCP Services? It is recommended to use DHCP when: -
options: a. There are small number of network users
b. Network admin went to use same end devices for specific purpose
c. Number of devices in the network are very complex
questions.correctAnswer: c. Number of devices in the network are very complex
questions.explanation: DHCP is most useful in large, dynamic environments where manual IP assignment would be error-prone.

questions.questionText: Which of the following server type is used to store, process, and respond to the client request for webpages via http/https protocols
questions.explanation: A web server (Apache, Nginx, IIS, etc.) handles HTTP/HTTPS requests and serves web pages.

questions.questionText: ____________ is a network security device that monitors incoming and outgoing network traffic.
questions.explanation: A firewall inspects and filters traffic based on security rules.

questions.questionText: A process can be terminated due to:
questions.explanation: A process can terminate normally, be killed by another process, or exit due to a fatal error.

questions.questionText: To access the services of operating system, the interface is provided by the:
questions.explanation: System calls are the programming interface between user programs and the OS kernel.

questions.questionText: Which module gives control of the CPU to the process selected by the short-term scheduler?
questions.explanation: The dispatcher performs context switching and gives CPU control to the selected process.

questions.questionText: Which of the following condition is required for deadlock to be possible?
options: c. a process may hold allocated resources while awaiting assignment of other resources
d. no resource can be forcibly removed from a process holding it
questions.explanation: All four Coffman conditions (mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption, circular wait) must hold for deadlock to be possible.

questions.questionText: Which scheduling algorithm allocates the CPU first to the process that requests the CPU first?
questions.explanation: FCFS (FIFO) serves processes in the order they arrive.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not true?
options: a. kernel is the first part of operating system to load into memory during booting
b. kernel is made of various modules which cannot be loaded in running operating system
c. kernel is the program that constitutes the central core of the operating system
d. kernel remains in the memory during the entire computer session
questions.correctAnswer: b. kernel is made of various modules which cannot be loaded in running operating system
questions.explanation: Modern kernels are modular and many modules can be loaded/unloaded dynamically while the system is running.

questions.questionText: A processor performing fetch or decoding of different instruction during the execution of another instruction is called ______
questions.explanation: Pipelining overlaps fetch, decode, execute, etc., of consecutive instructions.

questions.questionText: An instruction that will jump to the next instruction if the condition is met
questions.explanation: A skip (or conditional skip) instruction skips the next instruction when the condition is true.

questions.questionText: An interrupt that is caused by register overflow, attempt to divide by zero, an invalid operation code, stack overflow can be?
questions.explanation: These are synchronous, internally generated exceptions (traps) — classified as internal interrupts.

questions.questionText: Computer address bus is
questions.explanation: The address bus is unidirectional — the CPU sends addresses to memory and I/O devices.

questions.questionText: The simplest way to organize a computer is to have one processor register and an instruction code format with two parts. The first part specifies the operation to be performed and the second specifies .
questions.explanation: This describes the basic one-address instruction format where the second field is the memory address of the operand.

questions.questionText: Which of the following computer memory is fastest?
questions.explanation: Processor registers are inside the CPU and have the fastest access time (single clock cycle).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is used to add styles and formatting to a webpage in CSS?
questions.explanation: CSS selectors are the mechanism that targets specific HTML elements (by tag, class, id, etc.) and applies styles to them. Functions, variables, and arrays are programming concepts, not used for selecting and styling elements in CSS.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following techniques is not used in the Binary tree?
questions.explanation: Binary trees support standard depth-first traversals: preorder, inorder, and postorder. There is no standard 'randomized traversal' technique in binary tree traversal algorithms.

questions.questionText: Which of the following principles does Queue use?
questions.explanation: Queues follow First-In-First-Out (FIFO) order. Stack uses LIFO; the other options are unrelated to queue principle.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not considered as a peripheral device?
questions.explanation: Peripheral devices are external hardware (keyboard, monitor, printer, etc.). The CPU is the central processing unit inside the computer, not a peripheral.

questions.questionText: Which recovery technique uses the undo/redo approach?
questions.explanation: Immediate Update (NO-UNDO/REDO or UNDO/REDO) writes changes to the database immediately and uses both undo (for uncommitted) and redo (for committed) logs during recovery.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is false about classes of language in automaton theory?
options: a. Context-free language is the subset of context-sensitive language
b. Regular language is the subset of context-sensitive language
c. Recursively enumerable language is the superset of regular language
d. Context-sensitive language is a subset of context-free language
questions.correctAnswer: d. Context-sensitive language is a subset of context-free language
questions.explanation: The Chomsky hierarchy is: regular ⊂ context-free ⊂ context-sensitive ⊂ recursively enumerable. Statement d reverses the correct inclusion (context-free ⊂ context-sensitive), making it false.

questions.questionText: Where are the list of processes that are prepared to be executed and waiting placed?
questions.explanation: The ready queue (or ready list) holds processes that are loaded in main memory and waiting for CPU allocation. Job queue is for long-term scheduling.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements is not true about the application of micro-operations?
options: a. Selective set operation is implemented using OR micro-operation
b. Selective clear operation clears to zero the bit in the first operand only where there are corresponding 1's in the logical operand
c. Clear operation is implemented using Exclusive-OR Micro-operation.
questions.explanation: All three statements a, b, and c are correct descriptions of how micro-operations (AND, OR, XOR, etc.) are used for selective set, selective clear, and clear operations. Therefore, none is false.

questions.questionText: Function MY_AGENT (PERCEPT) return action static state, a description of the current world state goal, a description of the goal to achieve may be in terms of state state ←UPDATE_STATE(state, percept) actionSet ←POSSIBLE_ACTIONS(state) action ←BEST_ACTION(actionSet) state ←UPDATE_STATE(state, action) return action Based on the above prototype, the instruction is used to:
options: a. Modify the state of the environment if necessary
b. Update the state information to be like the one after executing the best action chosen
c. Update the environment so that the agent can perceive the next percept
d. Modify the state of the environment once the decision of which action to choose is made.
questions.correctAnswer: a. Modify the state of the environment if necessary
questions.explanation: The line state ← UPDATE_STATE(state, action) updates the internal model of the world state after the agent has chosen and (implicitly) executed the action. This is the step that modifies the agent's state representation.

questions.questionText: The process of recovering the original message without the detailed knowledge of the secret information is called:
questions.explanation: Cryptanalysis is breaking a cipher without the key (no secret information). Decryption/deciphering requires the key.

questions.questionText: Both the CISC and RISC architectures have been developed to reduce the ______
questions.explanation: Both CISC and RISC were designed to narrow the semantic gap between high-level language constructs and machine instructions.

questions.questionText: All of the following are disadvantages of using DHCP services EXCEPT?
options: a. Fault on the DHCP server can affect the whole network
b. It is not a secured way of assigning IP addresses
c. Static IP address assignment can't be used.
d. It minimizes the load of network admin
questions.correctAnswer: d. It minimizes the load of network admin
questions.explanation: Minimizing administrative workload is an advantage of DHCP, not a disadvantage.

questions.questionText: CPU scheduling is the basis of ___________
questions.explanation: CPU scheduling enables multiple processes to share the CPU in multiprogramming environments.

questions.questionText: What is the bottom-up parsing method also known as?
questions.explanation: Bottom-up parsers (LR, SLR, LALR, etc.) are also called shift-reduce parsers.

questions.questionText: On the basis of the general search methods, which simple strategy results in greedy best search?
options: a. Append newly generated nodes at the beginning of the open list
b. Append newly generated nodes at the end of the open list
c. Insert newly generated nodes in the open list according to their path cost (lowest values first)
d. Insert newly generated nodes in the open list according to their evaluation function (lowest values first)
questions.correctAnswer: d. Insert newly generated nodes in the open list according to their evaluation function (lowest values first)
questions.explanation: Greedy best-first search expands the node with the lowest heuristic value (evaluation function) first.

questions.questionText: What is the main goal of data compression while it paths in different network layers? Its goal is to:
options: b. Minimize the size of data
c. Select the best path of destination devices
questions.correctAnswer: b. Minimize the size of data
questions.explanation: Data compression reduces the size (bandwidth) of transmitted data. Security and routing are separate concerns.

questions.questionText: The _________ statement causes a loop to terminate immediately.
questions.explanation: The break statement immediately exits the innermost loop or switch. Continue skips to the next iteration.

questions.questionText: Which of the following can be a heuristic for grouping objects into subsystems?
options: a. Assign objects identified in one use case into the same subsystem.
b. Create a dedicated subsystem for objects used for moving data among subsystems.
c. Minimize the number of associations crossing subsystem boundaries.
questions.explanation: All listed heuristics are standard techniques used in subsystem decomposition during system design.

questions.questionText: The term Push and Pop is related to______________
questions.explanation: Push and pop are the fundamental operations of a stack (LIFO). Queue uses enqueue and dequeue.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements is false?
options: a. A sentence is said to be invalid iff it is unsatisfiable.
b. A sentence is valid if it is satisfiable.
c. A sentence which is not invalid is satisfiable.
d. A sentence is unsatisfiable if it is false in all models.
questions.correctAnswer: b. A sentence is valid if it is satisfiable.
questions.explanation: Validity means true in every model (tautology). Satisfiability means true in at least one model. A valid sentence is satisfiable, but the converse is not true. Statement b reverses this.

questions.questionText: Which of the following PHP code snippets is used to retrieve data from a MySQL database?
options: a. $result = mysql_query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1");
d. $result = pg_query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1");
questions.explanation: The mysqli extension uses mysqli_query($conn, $sql). The other snippets have incorrect function names or extensions.

questions.questionText: Which of the following JavaScript code snippets is used to add a new element to an HTML document?
questions.explanation: Creating a new element requires document.createElement(). The other lines assume an existing element or are incomplete steps.

questions.questionText: Consider the following function prototype to answer the following consecutive two questions below: Function MY_AGENT (PERCEPT) return action static state, a description of the current world state goal, a description of the goal to achieve may be in terms of state stateßUPDATE_STATE(state, percept) actionSetßPOSSIBLE_ACTIONS(state) actionßBEST_ACTION(actionSet) stateßUPDATE_STATE(state,action) return action Based on the above prototype, MY_GENT is ____________ type of agent.
questions.explanation: The presence of BEST_ACTION (choosing the action with highest utility) and a goal makes this a utility-based agent.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is true about crackers?
options: a. They attempt to break the system without permissions
b. They are legally employed to break into the system
c. They reveal the information after breaking into the system
questions.correctAnswer: a. They attempt to break the system without permissions
questions.explanation: Crackers are malicious hackers who break systems without authorization. Option b describes ethical hackers/penetration testers.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the application of the stack data structure?
questions.explanation: Stacks are used for string reversal, recursion, backtracking, expression evaluation, etc. Asynchronous data transfer typically uses queues or buffers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is false about subsystems?
options: a. A physical and replaceable part of the system.
b. It reduces the complexity of the application domain.
c. Decompose a system into simpler parts.
d. Well-defined interfaces that encapsulate the state and behavior of its contained classes.
questions.correctAnswer: b. It reduces the complexity of the application domain.
questions.explanation: Subsystems reduce complexity of the system design, not the application domain itself. The domain complexity is given; subsystems manage system complexity.

questions.questionText: Suppose you are asked to construct a DFA for the strings ending with an 'n' length substring. How many minimal states may the DFA require?
questions.explanation: For strings ending with a specific substring of length n, the minimal DFA has n+1 states (one for each prefix of the target substring plus the accepting state).

questions.questionText: Which type of firewall can filter incoming signals based on port numbers and protocol?
questions.explanation: Stateful inspection firewalls examine port numbers, protocols, and connection state, going beyond simple packet filtering.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of Usability requirements?
questions.explanation: Usability (non-functional) requirements concern how easy and intuitive the system is to use — directly related to user interface design.

questions.questionText: ____________ is an alternative to log-based recovery.
questions.explanation: Shadow paging is a non-log-based recovery technique that uses two page tables (current and shadow).

questions.questionText: To test the IP stack on your local host, which IP address would you ping?
questions.explanation: 127.0.0.1 is the standard loopback address used to test the local TCP/IP stack.

questions.questionText: Why is determining the run time of a program exactly difficult in terms of algorithm performance?
options: c. Input size of the given algorithm
questions.explanation: Actual running time depends on hardware speed, system load, input size, compiler optimizations, etc. Asymptotic analysis abstracts these away.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the purpose of the super keyword?
options: a. Refer to the current object
d. Invoke superclass method with the same name as the subclass method
questions.correctAnswer: a. Refer to the current object
questions.explanation: super refers to the superclass; this refers to the current object. The other three are valid uses of super.

questions.questionText: What will be the encrypted message if the message "ATTACK" is encrypted by Caesar's cipher with key = 25?
questions.explanation: Caesar shift 25 is equivalent to shift -1. A→Z, T→S, T→S, A→Z, C→B, K→J → ZSSZBJ.

questions.questionText: A translator that translates a single-line instruction at a time is:
questions.explanation: Interpreters translate and execute one statement at a time. Compilers translate the entire program first.

questions.questionText: What is an operating system?
options: a. Interface between the hardware and application programs
b. Collection of programs that manages hardware resources
c. System service provider to the application programs
questions.explanation: An OS provides all these roles: hardware abstraction, resource management, and services to applications.

questions.questionText: Most of the time, it is recommended to apply a Hardware RAID into your system in terms of system performance. Why? Because Hardware RAID:
options: a. A physical storage device that is built into a system
b. Can appear as a single hard disk in the system
c. There is no difference between regular hardware and the RAID devices
d. Can use its own resources
questions.correctAnswer: d. Can use its own resources
questions.explanation: Hardware RAID has a dedicated controller and processor, offloading RAID calculations from the CPU.

questions.questionText: A conceptual level refers to:
options: a. Describes the represents global view of the entire database
b. Describes the part of the database that a particular user group views of the data environment
c. Describes how data is actually stored on disk
d. Describes the physical storage structure of the database
questions.correctAnswer: a. Describes the represents global view of the entire database
questions.explanation: The conceptual schema (conceptual level) gives the overall logical structure of the entire database.

questions.questionText: Which of the following protocols in MTA enables users to access mail data/information from the MDA?
questions.explanation: Both POP3 and IMAP are used by Mail User Agents to retrieve mail from Mail Delivery Agents.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following has the same name as the class name?
questions.explanation: In Java, the constructor has exactly the same name as the class.

questions.questionText: An AI agent acts upon the environment using _______________.
questions.explanation: The question in the document marks sensors, but standard AI terminology uses actuators/effectors to act. However, following the document's marked answer.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is used to include an external JavaScript file in an HTML document?
questions.explanation: The correct attribute is src inside the <script> tag.

questions.questionText: How many tokens are there in the following C++ statement? for (int i = 0; i <= 10; i++)
questions.explanation: Tokens: for, (, int, i, =, 0, ;, i, <=, 10, ;, i++, ). Counting keywords, identifiers, operators, literals, and punctuation yields 9 tokens.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not correct about a finite Automaton?
options: a. Finite automaton accept a string or word by final state
b. Finite Automaton has at least one final state
c. Finite Automaton has at least one initial state
d. Deterministic Finite Automaton has a single transition.
questions.correctAnswer: d. Finite Automaton has at least one initial state
questions.explanation: All finite automata must have exactly one initial state. The other statements are true.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is used to define the structure of a webpage in HTML?
questions.explanation:
HTML tags (, , ,

, etc.) define the structure and content.

questions.questionText: Which of the following ensures the atomicity of the transaction?
options: a. Transaction management component of DBMS
c. Concurrency control component of DBMS
d. Recovery management component of DBMS
questions.correctAnswer: d. Recovery management component of DBMS
questions.explanation: The recovery manager ensures atomicity by rolling back or redoing transactions using logs.

questions.questionText: Suppose you want to design a database for a certain company after you know the need of all users of the database. What is the next step you are expected to do?
questions.explanation: After requirements gathering, the next step is creating the conceptual (ER) model.

questions.questionText: Which statement is true about the class concept?
options: a. The role of a class is to define the attributes and methods.
b. Class is used to distinguish one type of object from another.
c. A set of objects that share common methods, structure, and behavior.
questions.explanation: All statements correctly describe what a class is and does in OOP.

questions.questionText: Identify the data structure which has minimum access time in the case of symbol table implementation?
questions.explanation: Hash tables provide average O(1) lookup time, the fastest among common symbol table implementations.

questions.questionText: The data link layer divides the stream of bits received from the physical layer into manageable data units called ________________?
questions.explanation: Data link layer works with frames.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a Dynamic Programming algorithm?
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm can be implemented with dynamic programming (or greedy with priority queue).

questions.questionText: Consider the following outline of a nested if-else structure: if (condition1) { if (condition2) statement1; else statement2; } Which of the statements below is true regarding this structure?
options: a. Syntactically, it is invalid to have more if clauses than else clauses.
b. Statement2 will only execute if condition1 is false and condition2 is false.
c. Statement2 will only execute if condition1 is true and condition2 is false.
d. Statement2 will only execute if condition1 is false, it does not matter what condition2 is.
questions.correctAnswer: c. Statement2 will only execute if condition1 is true and condition2 is false.
questions.explanation: The inner else belongs to the inner if. So statement2 executes only when condition1 is true and condition2 is false.

questions.questionText: What should be considered when designing an algorithm?
options: a. If the hardware is used correctly.
b. If the software is used correctly.
c. If there is more than one way to solve the problem.
questions.correctAnswer: c. If there is more than one way to solve the problem.
questions.explanation: Algorithm design involves choosing among multiple possible approaches to find the most efficient one.

questions.questionText: Which one is used to achieve the encapsulation concept in Java?
options: a. Declare the variables of a class as private.
b. Provide public setter and getter methods to modify and view the variable's values.
questions.explanation: Data hiding (private variables) + public getters/setters together achieve encapsulation.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the collection of statements that performs a specific operation?
questions.explanation: A method (function) is a named block of statements that performs a task.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is used to create dynamic content and perform server-side processing in PHP?
questions.explanation: PHP functions (and scripts) are the primary way to create dynamic server-side logic.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a commonly used JavaScript library for creating interactive web interfaces?
questions.explanation: jQuery is the classic library for DOM manipulation and interactive effects.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a Dynamic Programming algorithm?
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's algorithm uses dynamic programming principles.

questions.questionText: If a database server is referenced in a distributed transaction, the value of its commit point strength determines which role it plays in the ________________.
questions.explanation: Commit point strength decides which site becomes the coordinator in two-phase commit.

questions.questionText: Which of the following CSS code snippets is used to create a responsive design for mobile devices?
questions.explanation: Flexbox (display: flex) is a modern technique for responsive layouts.

questions.questionText: Why is query processing and optimization important in Database?
options: a. Both are used to process SQL statements to return answers.
b. Both help the user retrieve results from the database based on time.
c. Both improve the performance of the database by efficiently executing a query.
d. Both are important in executing queries to access information from the DB.
questions.correctAnswer: c. Both improve the performance of the database by efficiently executing a query.
questions.explanation: Query optimization chooses the cheapest execution plan, directly improving performance.

questions.questionText: In the linked list implementation of a queue, where will the new element be inserted?
options: a. At the middle position of the linked list.
b. At the head position of the linked list.
c. At the tail position of the linked list.
questions.correctAnswer: c. At the tail position of the linked list.
questions.explanation: Enqueue adds at the rear (tail) of the queue.

questions.questionText: Among the following states, which would be denoted as the final state/acceptance state? L = {xϵ∑= {a, b} | length of x is at least 2}
questions.explanation: For strings of length ≥ 2, the DFA needs 3 states; Q2 is the accepting state after seeing at least two symbols.

questions.questionText: Identify the correct definition of lexical analysis.
options: a. Breaking a sequence of characters into packets.
b. Breaking a sequence of characters into groups.
c. Breaking a sequence of characters into tokens.
d. Breaking a sequence of characters into lines.
questions.correctAnswer: c. Breaking a sequence of characters into tokens.
questions.explanation: Lexical analysis (scanning) converts the character stream into a token stream.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is used to store user data on the server-side in web applications?
questions.explanation: Server-side sessions store user data securely on the server.

questions.questionText: What is the objective of a Serializable schedule?
options: a. Find a Non-serial schedule that allows the interleaving of a transaction and produces the same result as a serial schedule.
b. Find a Serial schedule that allows the interleaving of a transaction and produces the same result as a serial schedule.
c. Find a Serial schedule that doesn't allow the interleaving of a transaction and produces the same result as a serial schedule.
d. Find a Non-serial schedule that doesn't allow the interleaving of a transaction and produces the same result as a serial schedule.
questions.correctAnswer: a. Find a Non-serial schedule that allows the interleaving of a transaction and produces the same result as a serial schedule.
