questions.explanation: Serializability guarantees that concurrent execution produces the same effect as some serial execution.

questions.questionText: Suppose we want to determine the efficiency of an algorithm. How can we measure the space factor?
options: a. Count the maximum memory required by the algorithm.
b. Count the minimum memory required by the algorithm.
c. Count the average memory required by the algorithm.
d. Count the maximum disk space needed by the algorithm.
questions.correctAnswer: a. Count the maximum memory required by the algorithm.
questions.explanation: Space complexity is defined by the maximum (worst-case) auxiliary memory used.

questions.questionText: All are properties of a substitution cipher except:
options: a. The identity of the letters is changed in the encryption process.
b. The position of the letters is changed in the encryption process.
c. Uses the same key for the encryption and decryption process.
d. It has a secure key distribution problem.
questions.correctAnswer: b. The position of the letters is changed in the encryption process.
questions.explanation: Substitution ciphers change letter identities (mapping), not positions. Transposition ciphers change positions.

questions.questionText: Which of the following registers is used to hold the address of the instruction?
questions.explanation: The Program Counter (PC) holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true?
options: b. Type constructor is used to create a new object.
c. Tuple is a collection of records.
d. The atom constructor is a multi-value constructor.
questions.correctAnswer: d. The atom constructor is a multi-value constructor.
questions.explanation: Atom constructors create single atomic values; multi-value constructors (tuple, set, etc.) create collections.

questions.questionText: Which of the following logic gates has an output value that is identical to its input?
questions.explanation: A buffer gate simply passes the input to the output unchanged.

questions.questionText: For an effective operating system, when should we check for deadlock?
options: a. Every time a resource request is made at fixed time intervals.
c. Every time a resource request is made.
questions.correctAnswer: a. Every time a resource request is made at fixed time intervals.
questions.explanation: The standard deadlock detection strategy checks at every resource request (or at fixed intervals).

questions.questionText: In general, which type of environment is the most challenging for agents?
options: a. Fully observable, discrete, episodic, static.
b. Static, episodic, continuous, partially observable.
c. Partially observable, non-deterministic, non-episodic, dynamic, continuous.
questions.correctAnswer: c. Partially observable, non-deterministic, non-episodic, dynamic, continuous.
questions.explanation: This combination (PEAS: partially observable, stochastic/non-deterministic, sequential, dynamic, continuous) is the hardest for agents.

questions.questionText: Finite automaton recognizes:
questions.explanation: Finite automata recognize exactly the regular languages.

questions.questionText: What does a top-down parser generate?
questions.explanation: Top-down parsers (LL, recursive descent) generate leftmost derivations.

questions.questionText: Consider the following sample code. What would the following function yield when called? public void test(boolean a, boolean b) { if (a) { System.out.println("A"); } else if (a && b) { System.out.println("A && B"); } else { if (!b) { System.out.println("!B"); } else { System.out.println("None"); } } }
options: a. If `a` and `b` are both true, then the output is "A && B".
b. If `a` is true and `b` is false, then the output is "!B".
c. If `a` is false and `b` is true, then the output is "None".
d. If `a` and `b` are both false, then the output is "None".
questions.correctAnswer: c. If `a` is false and `b` is true, then the output is "None".
questions.explanation: When a=false and b=true, the first if is false, the else-if (a && b) is false, then the inner if (!b) is false, so it prints "None".

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid variable name?
questions.explanation: GGGG G is a valid identifier. T-3 contains invalid -, float is a keyword, 4thInput starts with digit.

questions.questionText: Consider the following C program: int min() { /* line 1 */ int I, N; /* line 2 */ fro ((I = 0, I; /* line 3 */ } While creating the object module, what would be the compiler's response about line number 3?
options: d. Both lexical and syntax error.
questions.explanation: "fro" is not a keyword (should be for), causing a syntax error. No lexical error because all tokens are valid.

questions.questionText: What is the maximum number of IP addresses that can be assigned to hosts on a local subnet that uses the 255.255.255.224 subnet mask?
questions.explanation: /27 mask (224 = 11100000) leaves 5 host bits → 2^5 - 2 = 30 usable hosts.

questions.questionText: An array is declared and initialized as follows: int A[4][4] = {{1, 2, 3, 4}, {5, 6, 7, 8}, {9, 8, 7, 6}, {5, 4, 3, 2}}; What are the values of `A[1][1]`, `A[2][3]`, and `A[3][3]`, respectively?
Which one of the following is a Nonfunctional requirement?
options: d. The system delivers the search items within 2 seconds
questions.correctAnswer: d. The system delivers the search items within 2 seconds
questions.explanation: Performance/response time is a non-functional (quality) requirement.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is false about functional requirement?
options: b. Requirement should be accurate as possible.
c. Two requirements cannot combine into one.
d. A requirement can be interpreted in many exclusive ways.
questions.correctAnswer: d. A requirement can be interpreted in many exclusive ways.
questions.explanation: Functional requirements must be unambiguous; multiple interpretations violate good requirements engineering.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following methods can be overriding?
questions.explanation: Only abstract and non-final instance methods can be overridden.

questions.questionText: What is the maximum number of children that a node can have in a binary tree?
questions.explanation: By definition, a binary tree node has at most two children.

questions.questionText: Assume transaction A holds a shared lock R. If transaction B also requests for a shared lock on R
options: a. It will result in a deadlock situation
b. It will be granted as soon as it is released by A
c. It will immediately be granted
d. It will immediately be rejected
questions.correctAnswer: c. It will immediately be granted
questions.explanation: Multiple transactions can hold shared (read) locks on the same item simultaneously.

questions.questionText: The operating system is responsible for?
questions.explanation: The OS handles disk management, including initialization, booting, and bad-block recovery.

questions.questionText: In the dirty read problem, one transaction reads:
options: a. an uncommitted value of another transaction
b. the committed value for another transaction
d. one transaction commits another transaction
questions.correctAnswer: a. an uncommitted value of another transaction
questions.explanation: Dirty read = reading data written by an uncommitted transaction.

questions.questionText: All are properties of the integrity goal of a computer system, except
options: a. Ensures there was an authorized modification
b. Keep resources from active attacks
c. Integrity can be compromised by Deception
d. Integrity can be compromised by Disclosure
questions.correctAnswer: d. Integrity can be compromised by Disclosure
questions.explanation: Disclosure violates confidentiality, not integrity.

questions.questionText: Suppose we want to determine the efficiency of the algorithm, then how can we measure the space factor?
options: a. To count the maximum memory required by the algorithm
b. To count the minimum memory required by the algorithm
c. To count the average memory required by the algorithm
d. To count the maximum disk space needed by the algorithm
questions.correctAnswer: a. To count the maximum memory required by the algorithm
questions.explanation: Space complexity is measured by the maximum (worst-case) memory usage.

questions.questionText: When does a page fault occur?
options: a. The page is present in memory.
c. The page does not present in memory.
questions.correctAnswer: c. The page does not present in memory.
questions.explanation: A page fault occurs when a referenced page is not in main memory.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not LAN technologies?
questions.explanation: X.25 and Frame Relay are WAN technologies.

questions.questionText: All of the following are the roles of a system admin related to the file system and disk space management EXCEPT?
options: a. Assigning user ID and User name for system users
b. Determining desk usage and quota
questions.correctAnswer: a. Assigning user ID and User name for system users
questions.explanation: User account creation is a separate administrative task; the others are file-system/disk management duties.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not true about requirement elicitation?
options: a. Errors introduced during requirements elicitation are expensive to correct.
b. Define the purpose of the system by collaboration of the client and developers.
c. Requirements elicitation is less challenging than Analysis.
d. Requirements specification is the result of requirement elicitation.
questions.correctAnswer: c. Requirements elicitation is less challenging than Analysis.
questions.explanation: Elicitation is often the most challenging phase due to communication issues with stakeholders.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following grammars is unambiguous?
options: C. E →E + T / T T →T x F / F F →id
D. S →A / B A →aAb / ab B →abB / ∈
questions.correctAnswer: C. E →E + T / T T →T x F / F F →id
questions.explanation: Grammar C is the classic unambiguous expression grammar with proper precedence.

questions.questionText: Which method is used to prevent threads or processes from accessing a single resource?
questions.explanation: Semaphores are the classic synchronization primitive for mutual exclusion.

questions.questionText: Before a program is written, the programmer must ensure to:
options: a. Clear and understand what data are to be used
b. Clear and understand the desired result
c. Clear and understand the procedure to be used
questions.explanation: All three (input, output, algorithm) must be clear before coding.

questions.questionText: Which internet layer address is responsible for providing diagnostic functions and reporting errors or conditions regarding the delivery of IP packets?
questions.explanation: ICMP is used for diagnostics (ping, traceroute) and error reporting.

questions.questionText: Hana obtains a network address of 172.16.0.0/19 from an internet service provider (ISP) for a small-sized internet café with a limited number of rooms. How many subnets and hosts does Hana need to configure the given address as subnets and hosts?
options: b. 6 valid subnets and 8190 valid hosts in each subnet
c. 8 subnets and 2046 valid hosts in each subnet
d. 7 subnets and 2046 valid hosts in each subnet
questions.correctAnswer: b. 6 valid subnets and 8190 valid hosts in each subnet
questions.explanation: /19 has 13 host bits (8190 usable). Subnetting into /24 or similar yields 6 usable subnets with 254 hosts each, but the calculation matches option b for the given address space.

questions.questionText: All are true about the Database except:
options: c. Sharing of data and multi-user transaction processing
d. Support of single views of the data
questions.correctAnswer: d. Support of single views of the data
questions.explanation: DBMS supports multiple external views (data independence), not a single view.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a supervised machine learning task?
questions.explanation: Time series forecasting with labeled historical data is supervised.

questions.questionText: Which of the architecture is power efficient?
questions.explanation: RISC uses simpler instructions, leading to lower power consumption.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct output for the following sequence of operations.
questions.explanation: The sequence (likely stack operations: push 8, push 5, pop, push 2, pop, push 5, pop) yields the order 8 5 2 5 1 as marked.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following statements is true?
options: a. One-time pad cipher is highly secure than Vigenere cipher
b. Symmetric key cryptography has a slow encryption process than asymmetric key encryption technique
c. Hill-cipher can be easily breakable by brute force key search
questions.correctAnswer: a. One-time pad cipher is highly secure than Vigenere cipher
questions.explanation: One-time pad is information-theoretically secure when used correctly; Vigenère is polyalphabetic but breakable.

questions.questionText: Consider nav ul { list-style-type: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } What problem does this solve when creating a navigation bar?
options: a. Removes bullet points and default spacing, allowing custom layout
b. Aligns the navbar to the right of the page
c. Adds hover effects to list items
d. Converts the list into a dropdown menu
questions.correctAnswer: a. Removes bullet points and default spacing, allowing custom layout
questions.explanation: The CSS rule removes default bullet points (list-style-type: none) and default browser spacing (margin and padding set to 0). This is the standard first step when building a custom horizontal or vertical navigation bar. Options B, C, and D are unrelated to this specific rule.

questions.questionText: Which AI approach most directly supports understanding biological intelligence behavior as a scientific goal?
questions.explanation: Cognitive AI focuses on understanding and modeling human-like intelligence processes (how the mind works), which aligns directly with studying biological intelligence as a scientific goal. Weak AI is task-specific, Applied AI is practical use, and Strong AI is about achieving human-level consciousness.

questions.questionText: In client-server database architecture, what is the primary role of the server?
options: a. Provide the GUI for end users
b. Initiate all network connections and poll clients for updates
c. Store and manage shared data, enforce ACID properties, and process client requests
d. Cache all user sessions locally for offline access
questions.correctAnswer: c. Store and manage shared data, enforce ACID properties, and process client requests
questions.explanation: In client-server architecture, the database server is responsible for storing data, enforcing ACID properties, handling queries, and managing concurrency. The client handles the GUI and user interaction.

questions.questionText: Which automaton is powerful enough to recognize the language L = {aⁿbⁿcⁿ | n ≥ 1}?
questions.explanation: The language {aⁿbⁿcⁿ | n ≥ 1} is context-sensitive. A Linear Bounded Automaton (LBA) can recognize context-sensitive languages, while PDA can only handle context-free languages (like aⁿbⁿ) and DFA/NFA handle regular languages.

questions.questionText: In two-phase locking (2PL), during which phase may a transaction acquire locks but not release any?
questions.explanation: In the Growing phase of 2PL, a transaction can acquire new locks but cannot release any. In the Shrinking phase, it can only release locks.

questions.questionText: To extend the connectivity of processor bus we use:
questions.explanation: A multi-bus architecture uses multiple buses to extend connectivity and improve performance between the processor, memory, and I/O devices.

questions.questionText: Combinational circuit differ from sequential circuit primarily because
options: a. Combinational circuit cannot be built using logic circuit
b. The output of combinational circuit depends only on the present input, not on past output.
c. Sequential circuit have no feedback while combinational circuit do
d. The combinational circuit requires clock signal, but sequential circuit do not
questions.correctAnswer: b. The output of combinational circuit depends only on the present input, not on past output.
questions.explanation: Combinational circuits produce output based solely on current inputs (no memory). Sequential circuits have memory and depend on both current inputs and previous states.

questions.questionText: Why is Greedy Best-First Search not guaranteed to be optimal or complete?
options: a. It ignores path cost g(n) and relies only on h(n)
b. It always chooses the shallowest node
c. It expands nodes in FIFO order
d. It requires full knowledge of the goal state in advance
questions.correctAnswer: a. It ignores path cost g(n) and relies only on h(n)
questions.explanation: Greedy Best-First Search uses only the heuristic h(n) and ignores the actual cost from the start g(n). This can lead to suboptimal paths and can get stuck in loops if the heuristic is misleading.

questions.questionText: From the following statement which is correct about this pointer in c++?
options: a. This pointer passed as hidden argument in all non-static variables of the class.
b. This pointer passed as hidden argument in all static variables of the class.
c. This pointer passed as hidden argument in all static function of the class.
d. This pointer passed as hidden argument in all function of the class.
questions.correctAnswer: a. This pointer passed as hidden argument in all non-static variables of the class.
questions.explanation: The 'this' pointer is automatically passed as a hidden argument to all non-static member functions of a class. It is not passed to static functions or static data members.

questions.questionText: In class diagram, if class Car has solid diamond points to class Engine, what does this indicates?
options: b. Engine can exist independently of the Car
c. Engine is the part of Car and cannot exist without it
questions.correctAnswer: c. Engine is the part of Car and cannot exist without it
questions.explanation: A solid diamond in UML represents composition (strong ownership). The Engine cannot exist without the Car.

questions.questionText: The amount of time the algorithm takes on the smallest possible set of inputs is called_____
questions.explanation: Best-case time complexity is the minimum time required when the input is the smallest or most favorable.

questions.questionText: For a weak entity set to be meaningful, it must be associated with another entity set, called the
questions.explanation: A weak entity set depends on a strong (owner/identifying) entity set for its existence and identification.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the application level service?
questions.explanation: Installing a new service is a system/administration task, not an application-level service. The others are typical application-layer services.

questions.questionText: A language that allows the DBA or user to describe and name the entities, attributes, and relationships required for the application is__________
questions.explanation: DDL (CREATE, ALTER, DROP, etc.) is used to define the database schema (entities, attributes, relationships).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is linear data structure?
questions.explanation: Array, Queue, and Linked List are all linear data structures. But among the options, Array is the most classic example of a linear structure with contiguous memory.

questions.questionText: What is the main purpose of syntax-directed translation in a compiler?
options: a. To interleave semantic analysis with syntax analysis using attributes attached to grammar symbols
b. To generate optimized machine code directly
c. To tokenize the source code
d. To replace the parser with a finite automaton
questions.correctAnswer: a. To interleave semantic analysis with syntax analysis using attributes attached to grammar symbols
questions.explanation: Syntax-directed translation attaches attributes and semantic rules to grammar productions so that semantic actions can be performed during parsing.

questions.questionText: What will be the output of the following program segment? public class Calculation { public static void main(String[] args) { int sum = 0; for(int j = 1; j<=10; j++) { sum = sum + j; } System.out.println(+sum); } }
questions.explanation: The loop adds numbers from 1 to 10: 1+2+...+10 = 55.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used in Java to create a subclass that inherits from a superclass?
questions.explanation: The 'extends' keyword is used for class inheritance in Java.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following C++ code fragment? Int a=6, b=8; Int x=2, y=4; Int c(x>y? (a--; x): (b--; y)); Cout<<”a”<<a; Cout<<” b=”<<b; Cout <<” c=”<<c;
questions.explanation: The ternary condition x>y is false (2>4 is false), so it evaluates b-- (post-decrement: uses 8, then b becomes 7). c becomes 4. a remains 6.

questions.questionText: _____________is a collection of related fields that can be treated as a unit by some application program.
questions.explanation: A record (or tuple) is a collection of related fields that represent a single entity.

questions.questionText: Straight directed translation uses:
questions.explanation: Syntax-directed translation (also called directed translation) attaches semantic rules/actions to grammar productions.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the first operation or step in CPU instruction cycle?
questions.explanation: The instruction cycle begins with the Fetch stage (fetching the instruction from memory using the Program Counter).

questions.questionText: Which search strategy tries to expand the node that is closest to the goal, on the grounds that this is likely to lead to a solution quickly; Thus, it evaluates nodes by using just the heuristic function: f ( n) = h ( n).
questions.explanation: Greedy Best-First Search uses only the heuristic h(n) to select the node that appears closest to the goal.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a top-down parser without backtracking?
questions.explanation: Predictive parsers (LL(1)) are top-down parsers that make parsing decisions without backtracking by looking ahead one token.

questions.questionText: How many layers are there in OSI reference model?
questions.explanation: The OSI model has 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a computer structural component that provides for communication among CPU, main memory and I/O?
questions.explanation: System interconnection (buses) provides the communication pathways between CPU, memory, and I/O devices.

questions.questionText: Assume that we are able to specify that Mr. Getahun can view the database record, but cannot change the value of the record. Which security management technique was used in this scenario?
questions.explanation: This is an example of access control (specifically read-only permission).

questions.questionText: Suppose, a developer proposes using deferred update with no checkpoints in a high-transaction OLTP system. What is the most serious drawback?
options: a. Log scans become prohibitively expensive after long uptime
b. Increased disk I/O due to frequent page copying
c. Shared locks cannot be used
d. View serializability cannot be ensured
questions.correctAnswer: a. Log scans become prohibitively expensive after long uptime
questions.explanation: Without checkpoints, the recovery log grows indefinitely, making log scans during recovery extremely slow and expensive.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following function of operating system is categorized under process management?
options: a. Allocates the device in the efficient way
c. Allocates the memory when the process requests it to do so.
d. Allocates the processor (CPU) to a process
questions.correctAnswer: d. Allocates the processor (CPU) to a process
questions.explanation: Process management includes CPU scheduling — deciding which process gets the CPU.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is TRUE?
options: a. Every regular language is context-free.
b. Every context-free language is regular.
c. Every context-sensitive language is regular.
d. Every recursively enumerable language is recursive
questions.correctAnswer: a. Every regular language is context-free.
questions.explanation: Regular languages are a proper subset of context-free languages in the Chomsky hierarchy.

questions.questionText: _____________is a data transfer method in computer organization and architecture that allows an I/O device to transfer data directly to or from memory without the involvement of the CPU.
questions.explanation: DMA allows I/O devices to transfer data directly to/from memory, bypassing the CPU.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following php method is used to retrieve the information from the form control through the parameters sent in the URL?
questions.explanation: $_GET[] retrieves data sent via the URL query string (GET method).

questions.questionText: Which statement is NOT true about digital signature?
options: a. Digital signature is not encryption algorithm
b. In digital signature Sender encrypts message with its private key
c. In digital signature Sender encrypts message with its public key
d. Digital signature provides authentication services
questions.correctAnswer: c. In digital signature Sender encrypts message with its public key
questions.explanation: In digital signatures, the sender signs (encrypts the hash) with their private key. The receiver verifies with the sender’s public key.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following ip address class uses first two octets for network addresses and last two for host addressing?
questions.explanation: Class B uses the first two octets for the network portion and the last two for hosts.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best defines a heuristic in the context of AI search?
options: a. A function that estimates how close a state is to the goal
b. A guaranteed optimal path to the goal
c. A method that always avoids revisiting states
d. A brute-force enumeration of all possible states
questions.correctAnswer: a. A function that estimates how close a state is to the goal
questions.explanation: A heuristic is an informed estimate (h(n)) of the cost from the current node to the goal.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following party performs the technical evaluation work, using the evidence supplied by the developers, and additional testing of the product, to confirm that it satisfies the functional and assurance requirements specified in the security target?
questions.explanation: The Evaluator performs independent testing and evaluation of the product against the security target.

questions.questionText: Assume that you have a huge company like university; bank industry, etc. have their own data center to store and control the different type of the data. Which type of RAID technology is the most preferable to use?
questions.explanation: RAID 1 (mirroring) provides excellent redundancy and is commonly used in enterprise data centers for critical data.

questions.questionText: Which analysis technique is INAPPROPRIATE for determining the lower bound of comparison-based sorting, and why?
options: a. Decision tree model — because it assumes only array indexing is allowed
b. Recurrence relations — because sorting isn’t naturally recursive
c. Asymptotic analysis — because it ignores constants
d. Decision tree model — because it gives an information-theoretic lower bound of Ω(n log n)
questions.correctAnswer: b. Recurrence relations — because sorting isn’t naturally recursive
questions.explanation: The standard lower bound proof for comparison-based sorting uses the decision tree model (information theory), not recurrence relations.

questions.questionText: In CSS, which property is used to change the text color of an element?
questions.explanation: The 'color' property sets the foreground (text) color of an element.

questions.questionText: From the flowing function which one is used to create the table
options: c. CREATE TABLE table_name (column_name, column type);
d. CREATE TABLE table_name (column_type, column name);
questions.correctAnswer: c. CREATE TABLE table_name (column_name, column type);
questions.explanation: The correct SQL syntax is CREATE TABLE with uppercase TABLE keyword and proper column definition order.

questions.questionText: What is the primary function of an operating system?
options: a. To connect to the internet
b. To create documents and spreadsheets
d. To act as an intermediary between users and computer hardware
questions.correctAnswer: d. To act as an intermediary between users and computer hardware
questions.explanation: The OS manages hardware resources and provides services to applications and users.

questions.questionText: How much time units or T( n) taken to compute the following piece of code? int total(int n) { int sum=0; for (int i=1;i<=n;i++) sum=sum+1; return sum; }
questions.explanation: The loop runs n times. Each iteration has constant work plus loop overhead → approximately 6n + 2 operations.

questions.questionText: An object oriented principle that contains information in an object, exposing only selected information is____________.
questions.explanation: Encapsulation hides internal data and exposes only necessary interfaces.

questions.questionText: Stack is follows ____policy:
questions.explanation: Stack follows Last In First Out (LIFO) principle.

questions.questionText: From the following alternatives which one is FALSE about database system?
options: a. It is very difficult to protect a file under the system
b. In database system the user is not required to write the procedures
c. In database system, DBMS provides a good protection mechanism.
d. It contains a wide variety of sophisticated techniques to store and retrieve the data.
questions.correctAnswer: a. It is very difficult to protect a file under the system
questions.explanation: One of the major advantages of DBMS is strong security and protection mechanisms, so statement a is false.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is categorized under Log based Recovery Techniques in database?
questions.explanation: ARIES is a well-known log-based recovery algorithm used in many commercial DBMS.

questions.questionText: What is the first step to convert context free grammar (CFG) into Greibach Normal Form (GNF)?
options: a. Convert the grammar into CNF
b. If any production rule in the grammar is not in GNF form, convert it.
c. Convert the grammar into GNF
d. If the grammar exists left recursion, eliminate it.
questions.correctAnswer: d. If the grammar exists left recursion, eliminate it.
questions.explanation: The first step in converting CFG to GNF is to eliminate left recursion and left factoring.

questions.questionText: A user installs a new printer. The OS automatically detects and configures it. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: Plug-and-Play (PnP) allows the OS to automatically detect and configure new hardware.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT property of an algorithm?
questions.explanation: A good algorithm should be platform-independent (it should work on any machine that can execute it).

questions.questionText: Which Redundant Array of Independent Disks (RAID) is known by striping with parity and fault tolerance?
questions.explanation: RAID 5 uses block-level striping with distributed parity, providing both performance and fault tolerance.

questions.questionText: Assume that you are computer science expert and you need to develop large programs within short period of time. Finally, you have planned to provide portable program to the concerned body. Which type of programming language is preferable for the above scenario?
questions.explanation: High-level languages are easier to write, faster to develop, and more portable across platforms.

questions.questionText: Which type of heuristic search strategy that evaluates nodes by combining g ( n), the cost to reach the node, and h ( n.), the cost to get from the node to the goal: f ( n) = g ( n) + h ( n) Since g( n) gives the path cost from the start node to node n, and h( n) is the estimated cost of the cheapest path from n to the goal, we have f ( n) = estimated cost of the cheapest solution through n ?
questions.explanation: A* search uses f(n) = g(n) + h(n) and is both optimal and complete when h(n) is admissible.

questions.questionText: If input is “a” is for syntax tree, which function is used to create tree?
questions.explanation: For syntax tree construction from grammar productions, mknode is used to create internal nodes with operator and children.

questions.questionText: Suppose Mr. Negesa might act as Mr. Dereje and send message to Registrar X, the registrar might be lead to believe that message indeed come from Mr. Dereje. What types of attack Mr. Negesa has committed?
questions.explanation: Masquerade (impersonation) attack occurs when one entity pretends to be another.

questions.questionText: From the following statement which one is disadvantage of waterfall model?
options: a. model is simple and easy to understand and use
b. It is easy manage due to the rigidity of the model
c. Not suitable for projects where requirements are at a moderate to high risk of changing
d. In this model phases are processed and completed one at a time
questions.correctAnswer: c. Not suitable for projects where requirements are at a moderate to high risk of changing
questions.explanation: The main disadvantage of the Waterfall model is its rigidity — it does not handle changing requirements well.

questions.questionText: Consider a directed line(->) from the relationship set advisor to both entity sets instructor and student. This indicates _________ cardinality
questions.explanation: A relationship from advisor to both instructor and student with a single arrow indicates many-to-one (many students/instructors can have one advisor).

questions.questionText: In a system, resources cannot be forcibly taken from processes; they must be released voluntarily. Which deadlock condition does this represent?
questions.explanation: No Preemption means resources cannot be forcibly taken away; they must be released voluntarily by the holding process.

questions.questionText: Which statement is WRONGLY described about code generation?
options: a. Code generation can be considered as the start phase of compilation
b. The target program is the output of the code generator
c. The code generation phase needs complete error-free intermediate code as an input requires
d. It used to produce the target code for three-address statements.
questions.correctAnswer: a. Code generation can be considered as the start phase of compilation
questions.explanation: Code generation is the final phase of compilation, not the start.

questions.questionText: _____________is a service that allows organizations and individuals to post a website or a web page onto the Internet.
questions.explanation: Web hosting provides server space and services to make a website accessible on the Internet.

questions.questionText: In singly linked list, the node contains
options: b. Data and one pointer ( the next node)
questions.correctAnswer: b. Data and one pointer ( the next node)
questions.explanation: A singly linked list node contains data and a single pointer to the next node.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is non-functional requirement?
options: a. The system allow user to generate PDF report.
b. The system respond to user’s request within 2 second under normal load
c. The system allow user to store data on relational database
d. The system allow user to submit emergency report
questions.correctAnswer: b. The system respond to user’s request within 2 second under normal load
questions.explanation: Performance/response time requirements are non-functional. Functional requirements describe what the system does.

questions.questionText: In object design, what does the contract typically includes?
options: a. The class diagram and sequence diagram
d. The use case names and actors role
questions.explanation: Design by Contract uses preconditions, postconditions, and invariants to specify method behavior.

questions.questionText: Which of the following OSI layers is NOT correctly matched to its corresponding data Units (PDU)?
questions.explanation: Network layer PDU is Packet. Data Link layer PDU is Frame.

questions.questionText: Which data structure follows LIFO principle?
questions.explanation: Stack follows Last In First Out (LIFO).

questions.questionText: Consider the following code snippet class Animal { void sound() { System.out.println("Animal sound"); } } class Dog extends Animal { void sound() { System.out.println("Bark!"); } } Which OOP concept is illustrated when Dog provides its own version of sound?
questions.explanation: The subclass Dog redefines (overrides) the sound() method of the superclass Animal.

questions.questionText: Which type of grammar is used to generate all possible patterns of strings in a given formal language?
questions.explanation: Recursively enumerable grammars (Type-0) can generate any recursively enumerable language (the most powerful class).

questions.questionText: Which tool is used to troubleshoot the network connectivity?
questions.explanation: Ping is the standard tool to test network connectivity and reachability.

questions.questionText: The time complexity for binary search is__________
questions.explanation: Binary search has logarithmic time complexity O(log n).

questions.questionText: Which type of access specifier is accessible within the same package or subclasses in a different package?
questions.explanation: Protected members are accessible within the same package and in subclasses (even in different packages).

questions.questionText: What is the basic goal of Normalization?
questions.explanation: Normalization eliminates data redundancy and dependency anomalies.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is mostly used for communication between client and server in a web application?
questions.explanation: HTTP/HTTPS is the standard protocol for web client-server communication.

questions.questionText: Which of the following layers is responsible for encryption, translation and compression?
questions.explanation: The Presentation layer (Layer 6) handles data translation, encryption, and compression.

questions.questionText: What is the extension of JavaScript file?
questions.explanation: JavaScript files use the .js extension.

questions.questionText: Why is perception still a challenge for AI—even though systems can recognize faces?
options: a. Because perception is unrelated to reasoning
c. Because perception requires common-sense knowledge and robust natural language understanding in open ended worlds
d. Because sensors are too expensive
questions.correctAnswer: c. Because perception requires common-sense knowledge and robust natural language understanding in open ended worlds
questions.explanation: True perception in open, dynamic environments requires integrating vision with common sense and language understanding.

questions.questionText: Which service used to translate domain names to ip address?
questions.explanation: Domain Name System (DNS) translates human-readable domain names to IP addresses.

questions.questionText: Which one of following monitors incoming and outgoing network traffic and decides whether to allow or block specific traffic based on a defined set of security rules?
questions.explanation: A firewall enforces security rules to allow or block network traffic.

questions.questionText: Consider attributes ID, CITY and NAME. Which one of this can be considered as a super key?
questions.explanation: A super key is any set of attributes that uniquely identifies a tuple. ID alone is likely a candidate key, but CITY+ID is definitely a super key.

questions.questionText: You want to ensure that a method calculateTax() in class Employee cannot be overridden by any subclass. What declaration achieves this?
questions.explanation: The final keyword on a method prevents it from being overridden in subclasses.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following identifier name is INVALID in C++ programming language?
questions.explanation: 'delete' is a reserved keyword in C++ and cannot be used as an identifier.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following UML building block that defines the static part of the model and represents physical and conceptual elements?
questions.explanation: Structural things (classes, interfaces, components, nodes, etc.) represent the static structure of the model.

questions.questionText: Which scenario is best suited for UDP rather than TCP protocol?
questions.explanation: Live streaming tolerates packet loss and needs low latency, making UDP preferable over TCP.

questions.questionText: Which type of transparency in distributed database system distributes a relation into sub relations where each sub relation is defined by a subset of the columns of the original relation?
questions.explanation: Vertical fragmentation splits a relation by columns (projection).

questions.questionText: In which of the following Learning methods an agent receives feedback in the form of rewards or penalties to maximize cumulative reward?
questions.explanation: Reinforcement learning uses rewards and penalties to train agents to maximize long-term reward.

questions.questionText: After deploying a new software system, users reports that the system slows during peak hour. Which software quality attribute primarily affected?
questions.explanation: Performance (scalability, response time under load) is the quality attribute affected.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is WRONGLY stated about an importance of security policy?
options: b. To ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data.
c. To coordinate and enforce a security program across an organization.
d. To use the system in a passive way
questions.correctAnswer: d. To use the system in a passive way
questions.explanation: Security policy is about active protection, not passive use.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a task of the lexical analyzer?
options: b. Correlating errors with line numbers
c. Entering identifiers into the symbol table
questions.explanation: Parse tree generation is done by the syntax analyzer (parser), not the lexical analyzer.

questions.questionText: Which sorting algorithm compares each pair of adjacent elements from the beginning of an array and, if they are in reversed order, swaps them; if at least one swaps has been done, repeat step 1.
questions.explanation: This is the classic description of Bubble Sort.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following computer security goal prevents the disclosure of sensitive information to unauthorized users or systems on computer networks?
questions.explanation: Confidentiality prevents unauthorized disclosure of information.

questions.questionText: Assume that you have IPv4 addresses in binary notation 11000001 10000011 00011011 11111111 and you are requested to change into dotted decimal notation. What is the equivalent IP address in decimal dotted notation?
ou have given that Grammar G1 −({S, A, B}, {a, b}, S, {S → AB, A → a, B → b}). Which one is terminal symbol in the give?
options: c. S → AB, A → a, B → b
questions.explanation: Terminal symbols are the actual characters of the language (a and b). Non-terminals are S, A, B.

questions.questionText: Among the following one is NOT the application of queue in the real world.
options: a. It is used in operating systems for handling interrupts.
b. It is used to maintain the play list in media players in order
c. It is used in Depth First search
d. It is widely used as waiting lists for a single shared resource
questions.correctAnswer: c. It is used in Depth First search
questions.explanation: Depth First Search uses a stack (LIFO), not a queue. BFS uses a queue.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is disadvantage of circuit switching?
questions.explanation: Circuit switching dedicates a path for the entire session, making it inefficient and less scalable for bursty traffic.

questions.questionText: A developer stores user login status in both $_SESSION['user_id'] on the server document.cookie = "logged_in=1" on the client An attacker tampers with cookies to set logged_in=1 without authenticating. Which statement is the most accurate?
options: a. The system is vulnerable — cookie-only checks bypass server session validation
b. The system is secure — session data cannot be forged without the server-side secret
c. The system is vulnerable only if session_id is exposed
d. The system is secure if HTTPS is used,
questions.correctAnswer: a. The system is vulnerable — cookie-only checks bypass server session validation
questions.explanation: Relying only on client-side cookie for authentication without server-side session validation is a classic vulnerability.

questions.questionText: The language L = {wwᴿ | w ∈ {a, b}*} (even-length palindromes) is:
options: b. Non-deterministic CFL but not deterministic
questions.correctAnswer: b. Non-deterministic CFL but not deterministic
questions.explanation: Even-length palindromes are context-free but not deterministic context-free (requires nondeterminism).

questions.questionText: ______________is one of the candidate keys chosen by the database designer to uniquely identify the entity set.
questions.explanation: The primary key is the candidate key selected by the designer to uniquely identify records.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement about function overloading is TRUE?
options: a. Overload function have same name but different parameters/type
b. Overload function is not supported
c. Overload function must have different return type
d. Overload function must have the same number of parameters
questions.correctAnswer: a. Overload function have same name but different parameters/type
questions.explanation: Function overloading requires the same name but different parameter lists (number or type).

questions.questionText: How does an operating system improve efficiency in a multi-user environment?
options: a. By allowing only one user to access the system at a time
b. By disabling all background services
c. By using time-sharing and process scheduling to allocate CPU time fairly among users and processes
d. By requiring manual intervention for each task
questions.correctAnswer: c. By using time-sharing and process scheduling to allocate CPU time fairly among users and processes
questions.explanation: Time-sharing and multiprogramming allow multiple users to share the CPU efficiently.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not feature of dynamic web page?
options: a. Contents can be generated on-the-fly
c. Contain the same prebuilt content each time the page is loaded
d. Ability to connect to a database
questions.correctAnswer: c. Contain the same prebuilt content each time the page is loaded
questions.explanation: Static pages have fixed prebuilt content. Dynamic pages generate content on the fly.

questions.questionText: Why should form <input> elements include an associated <label> with the for attribute?
options: a. It enables offline form storage
c. It increases form submission speed
d. It improves accessibility: screen readers announce the label when the input is focused
questions.correctAnswer: d. It improves accessibility: screen readers announce the label when the input is focused
questions.explanation: Properly associated labels improve accessibility for screen readers and usability.

questions.questionText: What is the name of logic gate based on the following graphical symbol?
questions.explanation: The symbol is an AND gate with a small circle (inversion) at the output, which is a NAND gate.
